summary: Iteration 24 (frontend-only re-verification): Confirmed the iter23 fix in /app/frontend/app/sign-in.tsx. All three login paths — top CTA (testID='signin-top-cta'), bottom submit (testID='signin-submit'), and password onSubmitEditing (Enter key) — now correctly invoke onSubmit() without leaking the GestureResponderEvent. Logged in as kishan / Kishan@Boss2026 across all three paths and landed on the dashboard (overview-header, stat-grid, active-trips-card, bullion, ledger cards all rendered). No red-screen and no '.trim is not a function' TypeError observed in any path. Regression check: the floating-jarvis sidebar opens correctly after login and shows the Wingman assistant chat history intact (previous messages visible, composer active).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking on web but should be migrated for RN 0.76+/expo-52+. Reference: /app/frontend/app/sign-in.tsx:255-259, 330-336, 355-358.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking, cosmetic.
Console warning: useNativeDriver not supported on web preview — falling back to JS animation. Expected on web; native builds will use RCTAnimation. No action required unless targeting web perf.

action_items: No functional action required for the reported bug — the fix is verified working across all 3 login paths.
(Optional / low priority) Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents' to 'style.pointerEvents' across the app to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.

onSubmit's default parameters (overrideUsername/overridePassword) use `??` fall-through to state, which is safe once the event-leak is removed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sign-in event-leak bug is closed. Primary username+password login is fully functional via all 3 UI entry points. Floating Jarvis sidebar opens post-login and Wingman chat history renders correctly. Deprecation warnings in console are cosmetic only.
rca_of_issue: Original bug (iter23): onPress={onSubmit} passed the RN GestureResponderEvent as the first arg (overrideUsername), then `.trim()` on the event object threw a TypeError red-screen. Fix (iter24): wrapping with `() => onSubmit()` at all 3 sites (Pressable onPress lines 109 & 177, TextInput onSubmitEditing line 161) prevents the event from being passed. Verified end-to-end in the web preview at https://cyber-logistics-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com.
